## Rule
Motif-ray-extend: find the 3×3 motif (its color = source color); short single-
colour marker segments sit adjacent to it; each marker stamps the motif shape,
recoloured to the marker colour, repeated at **stride 4** along its ray to the
grid edge. Numpy spec: `tests/test_detect.py::Task005MotifRayExtendTest`.
